title: CISA CVE Vulnrichment Dataset
subtitle: Comprehensive CVE data with CVSS metrics and SSVC scores
description:
This dataset contains detailed vulnerability information extracted from the CISA vulnrichment repository, including CVE identifier details, latest CVSS base metrics, SSVC decision scores, and list of affected products (w/ product versions). The data is automatically updated daily to provide the most current vulnerability intelligence.

## Dataset Contents

- **CVE Identifiers**: Unique vulnerability identifiers
- **CVSS base Metrics**: Complete base metric scoring including base score, exploitability and impact metrics .
- **SSVC Scores**: Stakeholder-Specific Vulnerability Categorization decisions
- **Impact Analysis**: Technical impact assessments and exploitability information
- **Product Information**: Affected vendors, products, and vulnerable versions
- **CWE Classifications**: Common Weakness Enumeration mappings
- **KEV Status**: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities inclusion

## Data Schema

The CSV contains the following columns:
- `cve_id`: CVE identifier (e.g., CVE-2023-12345)
- `published_date`: Initial publication date
- `updated_date`: Last modification date
- `base_score`: CVSS v3.1 base score (0-10)
- `base_severity`: Severity rating (NONE, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)
- `attack_vector`: Attack vector (NETWORK, ADJACENT_NETWORK, LOCAL, PHYSICAL)
- `attack_complexity`: Attack complexity (LOW, HIGH)
- `privileges_required`: Required privileges (NONE, LOW, HIGH)
- `user_interaction`: User interaction requirement (NONE, REQUIRED)
- `scope`: Scope (UNCHANGED, CHANGED)
- `attack_requirements`: This metric captures the prerequisite deployment and execution conditions or variables of the vulnerable system that enable the attack
- `confidentiality_impact`: CIA impact (NONE, LOW, HIGH)
- `integrity_impact`: CIA impact (NONE, LOW, HIGH)
- `availability_impact`: CIA impact (NONE, LOW, HIGH)
- `ssvc_exploitation`: SSVC exploitation status
- `ssvc_automatable`: SSVC automatability assessment
- `ssvc_technical_impact`: SSVC technical impact
- `ssvc_decision`: SSVC final decision (Track, Attend, Act)
- `cisa_kev`: Known Exploited Vulnerability status (TRUE/FALSE)
- `cisa_kev_date`: Date added to KEV catalog
- `impacted_vendor`: Primary affected vendor
- `impacted_products`: List of affected products
- `vulnerable_versions`: List of vulnerable versions
- `cwe_number`: Common Weakness Enumeration ID
- `cwe_description`: CWE description

## Update Frequency

This dataset is automatically updated daily using GitHub Actions, ensuring you always have access to the latest vulnerability data from CISA's vulnrichment repository.

## Data Source

Data is extracted from the official CISA vulnrichment repository: https://github.com/cisagov/vulnrichment

## Use Cases

- Vulnerability research and analysis
- Risk assessment and prioritization
- Security dashboard development
- Threat intelligence integration
- Academic research in cybersecurity
- Compliance and audit activities

## License

This dataset is provided under the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal license, allowing for unrestricted use.

resources.description: Complete CVE dataset with vulnerability metrics, CVSS-B (base) scores, SSVC decisions, and product information

fields.name: base_severity
fields.description: Severity rating (NONE, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)

fields.name: user_interaction
fields.description: User (other than attacker) interaction requirement. For v3.1 (NONE, REQUIRED), for v4.0 (NONE, ACTIVE, PASSIVE)

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Describes whether subsequent systems attached to the vulnerable systems can be affected as well. ONLY VALID FOR CVSS v3.1 (UNCHANGED, CHANGED)

fields.name: attack_requirements
fields.description: This metric captures the prerequisite deployment and execution conditions or variables of the vulnerable system that enable the attack. ONLY VALID FOR CVSS v4.0 (NONE, PRESENT)

fields.name: confidentiality_impact
fields.description: Level of impact on the confidentiality. For v3.1 only impact on vulnerable system [VC], for v4.0 impact on both vulnerable and subsequent system(s) [VC, SC] (NONE, LOW, HIGH)

fields.name: integrity_impact
fields.description: Level of impact on the integrity. For v3.1 only for impact on vulnerable system [VI], for v4.0 impact on both of affected and subsequent system(s)[VI, SI] (NONE, LOW, HIGH)

fields.name: availability_impact
fields.description: Level of impact on the availability. For v3.1 only for impact on the vulnerable system [VA], for v4.0 impact on both vulneable and subsequent system(s) [VA, SA] (NONE, LOW, HIGH)
